environment.note: Tranche 11a - iteration/sequence family for Phase 6 gesture construction. SoundThread has zero coverage of these targets; afta8 covers all six. Fixtures: short decaying pings (0.3/0.6 s) as one-shot iteration sources; 25-file semitone set for iterlinef. To be re-verified on macOS r8 by the CDP-gated suite after integration.

entries.duration_row_reason: Multi-input (2+) entry; incompatible with the single-input duration fixture. Rule pinned (exact to 4 dp on 9 probe sequences incl. transposed, curtailed, chord, and early-long-tail cases): outdur = MAX over events of (time_i + min(indur[snd_i] / 2^((pitch_i - notional_i)/12), dur_i)). Engine spot-check reproduced 1.1500 exactly through process_impl.
notes: TRANCHE PRIORITY - Phase 6 timeline() empirics. Duration rule is the MAX over events, NOT the last listed event: an earlier event's tail past the last event's end IS kept (t=0 event lasting 1.2 s + last event ending 0.55 rendered 1.2000). Listed duration CURTAILS (end-splice of 'splice' ms) but NEVER EXTENDS (dur 5.0 on a 0.3 s source still ended at time+0.3).

Transposition is SAMPLE-RATE RESAMPLING: +12 st = half length/double speed (event measured 1314 Hz from a 660 Hz source, outdur followed indur/2^(st/12) exactly). Notional pitch purely relative: notional 60/event 72 byte-identical to notional 76/event 88.

SEQUENCE FILE SYNTAX: float-stream parse - line structure cosmetic (one-line file byte-identical to line-per-event); ';' comments; line 1 = notional MIDI pitch per input (0-127); then 5-value groups sound#/time/pitch/loudness/dur. Times non-decreasing (equal = chords); refusals all verbatim in the transcript. Loudness > 1 ACCEPTED (banner 0-1 advisory); negative refused. Duration floor fixed 2 ms (independent of -s). Event count mismatch refused.

OVERLOAD warns but writes raw float sums (3-note chord peak 1.8052, exit 0) - no clip, no wrap. attenuation CDP-enforced 0-1, and 0 is accepted -> DIGITAL SILENCE (curated min 0.000002). splice -s 2-200 ms default 2 (flag-less == -s2 byte-identical); only audible when an event is curtailed. Both params refuse brk files (parameters 1/2 verbatim).

Channel/srate gates verbatim: all inputs one channel count and one sample rate ('Incompatible channel-count/sample-rate in input file ...'); mono in -> mono out (contrast sausage). Variadic upstream (3-input verified); entry pins arity 2. Time ceiling NOT enforced: t=7300 event rendered a 1.29 GB file exit 0 - engine cap is the guard.
Deterministic (identical decoded shas 1.2 s apart); no seed exists. afta8's attenuation -10..10/def 0.9 wrong (CDP 0-1 def 1.0).

Duration model exact on 7 probes at 2 input durations (rand/pshift 0): actual = delay*(ceil(outduration/delay)-1) + indur, delay defaulting to indur - equals outduration when it divides evenly, else overshoots by < delay+indur (2.0 at delay 0.3 -> 2.1). Curated set_by outduration with the row at outduration 6.0 (delay defaults to the 2 s fixture -> exact 6.0).

SEED HUNT: -s > 0 WORKS (srand(seed), extprepro.c:1133; same seed byte-identical 1.3 s apart, 5 vs 9 differ); -s0 AND omission are the CLOCK path (initrand48 = srand(time(0)); timed pairs differ); seed INERT at rand=pshift=ampcut=0 (s5 == s9 == unseeded byte-identical). Entry defaults seed to 1.

FADE IS DETERMINISTIC (banner's '(average)' misleading): two unseeded -f0.3 runs byte-identical; geometric decay gain_n ~ (1-fade)^n (envelope 0.75/0.55/0.385/0.27/0.19). FADE BRK IS BROKEN: accepted syntactically, always aborts 'ERROR: No significant signal level found' (with and without -g1) - breakpoint_capable false with the bug documented.
delay/rand/pshift/ampcut breakpoints all VERIFIED distinct from both scalar endpoints at seed 5 (delay by duration 0.9742 vs 0.8/2.3). gain/outduration/seed refuse brks (parameters 7/1/8 verbatim).
Ranges verbatim: outduration (indur to 32767); delay (0.000002 to 100) but -d0 ACCEPTED = all copies stacked at t=0 (unison; duration = indur); rand/ampcut/fade/gain 0-1; pshift 0-12; seed 0-32767.

gain 0 (default) auto-levels ~1/(overlap count) (== -g0.5 envelope at delay=indur/2); -g1 unity (overlap peak 0.865 from 0.77 source). Stereo accepted. Mode 1 outdur 1.8 BYTE-IDENTICAL to mode 2 reps 5 - one engine, two stop conditions.

Duration model exact on 7 probes at 2 input durations: outdur = repetitions * delay + indur (repetitions counts EXTRA copies; total events = repetitions+1). Fractional repetitions ROUNDED (2.5 -> 3, duration 1.2000). Curated expression 'repetitions * delay + indur'.

CURATED-INTERFACE CONSTRAINT: delay must be passed explicitly - CDP's own default (delay = indur) is input-dependent and inexpressible as a schema default, so omitting it fails the engine preflight with predicted_duration_evaluation_failed naming 'delay' (verified through process_impl). The render itself would be fine; documented in known_issues.

repetitions CDP-enforced 1-32767 (0 refused verbatim; afta8's 1-100 advisory). All other params/ranges/seed/fade/brk behavior identical to submode 1 and re-verified (seed hunt ran in this mode: clock at 0, working at >0, inert at zero random params; fade brk broken; delay 0 stacks copies).
Engine spot-check: reps 5/delay 0.15/seed 5 on a 0.3 s ping -> 1.0500 measured vs 1.05 predicted, exact.

breakpoint_duration_source 'max' on the four capable params (all set members ~equal length; envelope axis documented as output-time with the absolute-.brk escape hatch).

THE BOUNCING-BALL OP. Mode content verified on a decaying ping: mode 1 keeps the ATTACK of every repeat (repeat-4 envelope started at the 0.771 attack level; mode 2 middle 0.175, mode 3 tail 0.044, mode 4 around the chosen time 0.693). All four modes share one event grid (identical durations, distinct shas).

DURATION: at contract = 1 EXACT - repeats start at multiples of gap strictly below dur, output = last start + gap (probes 3.2/2.5/3.5 at gaps 0.4/0.5/0.7 plus the row pair 2.0/6.0 -> 6.0000 exact and 2.0/6.5 -> 8.0000, two input durations, incl. shrinkage 0; curated expression 'gap * (((dur - 0.000001) // gap) + 1)'). FLOAT BORDERLINE: dur an exact decimal multiple of a NON-binary-exact gap gains one extra gap (0.3/0.9 rendered 1.2000 - 3*float(0.3) lands just under 0.9). At contract < 1 the geometric gap series HALTS when gaps contract to the shrunken-sound floor - 1.9321 rendered from dur 3.0: the banner's 'DUR (Minimum) duration' is FALSE without -m. -m regularises the grid at the floor and runs out to dur (3.0806); small dur truncates (1.1808 from 1.0 at contract 0.8). Expression over-predicts (safe) when contract < 1.

RANDOMISATION IS FIXED-SEQUENCE AND GATED (first-class): -r is a NO-OP without -m (-r0.5 byte-identical to no flag); with -m it is live (differs from no-r and scales with value) but UNSEEDED-UNSEEDABLE-DETERMINISTIC - no srand/initrand48 anywhere in new/shrink.c, the osbind drand48 shim runs from rand()'s fixed default, and 1.3 s-apart identical commands rendered byte-identical. stochastic false; version_sensitive true (a build with real drand48 seeding would differ).

CRASH LANDMINE: -s (small) larger than the input duration SEGFAULTS (exit 139, no message). Runtime gates verbatim: contract >= shrinkage ('Contraction of inter-events distance can't be less than shrinkage of sounds.'); -m < gap ('Minimum event separation must be less than initial event separation.').

Ranges verbatim: shrinkage 0-1 (0 legal = pure repeats); gap (indur to 60); contract 0-1; dur (2*indur to 32767); spl 2-50 ms; rnd 0-1. ALL EIGHT params refuse breakpoints (parameters 2-9, each probed).
-n (equalise levels) byte-identical no-op in this mode on attack-fronted material; -i (per-segment reverse) live. Stereo accepted. Engine spot-check: 0.7/0.4/1.0/3.0/10 -> 3.2000 measured, exact.
